# D0 summary tables (generated by d0/summarize.py; descriptive only, no ranking)

All values are light emitted by the parametric display (cd/m²) decoded with `d0/display_model.py`; `SCENE` rows are the physical scene. P_det is HDR-VDP-3 side-by-side detection of the bar: a diagnostic under HDR-VDP's observer model, not a human probability.
